summary: Iteration 3 validation of TPM counts + AI blocker analysis. Backend: extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py from 35 -> 42 tests; all 42 pass (fixed one iter1 assertion that still expected target_coverage on /api/tpms rows). New coverage: /api/tpms rows carry integer trinity/manual/harness/manual_qc/absent + pod_count/project_count/attention (Prafful Gupta headcount=106 verified); /api/tpms/{name} returns counts{trinity,manual,harness,manual_qc,on_leave} + overview_insight + pods[].insight; /api/pods/{name} returns counts + blocker_analysis key (nullable); POST /api/pods/{name}/analyze requires auth, 404s on missing POD, and for 'Vidit Sharma' returns {pod, reporting_date, revision, generated_at, generated_by, result:{headline, blockers[>=1 with issue/count/detail], no_remark_count, recommendation, model:'claude-haiku-4-5'}}, then cached in subsequent GET /api/pods/Vidit%20Sharma. /api/summary regression still returns kpis+pods with members=333. Frontend E2E as admin: /tpms table headers exact match ['TPM','Headcount','PODs','Projects','Trinity','Manual','Harness/GK','Manual QC','Absent','Attention'] with 0 progressbars; first row 'Prafful Gupta 106 5 3 86 3 3 5 6 11'. TPM detail shows tpm-counts 5-cell strip ['86 Trinity','3 Manual','3 Harness/GK','5 Manual QC','6 Absent'] plus overview_insight banner + KPI cards + charts + PODs sub-table (Headcount/Attention/no coverage bars). POD detail (/pods/Vidit%20Sharma) shows pod-counts 5-cell strip ['0 Trinity','17 Manual','2 Harness/GK','1 Manual QC','1 Absent'], blocker-analysis card with run-blocker-analysis button. Clicking the button calls POST /analyze, spinner shows, and blocker-result renders headline ('Claude API limits and access constraints are preventing 13+ contributors from completing manual dataset creation tasks.') + 3 blockers with counts (4,3,2) and details (Claude API limit exhausted / Difficulty band QC failures / No engineering support). Reopening the POD renders the cached blocker-result immediately (length ~1034 chars) without spinner. LLM latency was ~10-15s, within budget.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now ~940 lines mixing auth+sync+queries+routes+LLM route; increasingly worth splitting into routers/analysis modules.
CORS: allow_credentials=True with allow_origins default '*' still present when CORS_ORIGINS env is unset — carried over. Set an explicit origin list in prod.
analysis.py fallback path (LLM returns non-JSON) drops blockers=[] but still upserts to db; consider raising or flagging low-confidence so UI can distinguish parsed vs raw fallback.
POST /api/pods/{name}/analyze has no rate-limit / debounce and no viewer/admin restriction — a viewer can spend LLM credits. Consider requiring admin or per-pod-per-minute cap.
_ws_counts.on_leave is surfaced as 'absent' in /api/tpms and 'on_leave' in TPM detail counts; label inconsistency between endpoints (frontend handles it but future consumers may be confused).
blocker_analyses cache key is (pod, reporting_date, revision); no TTL. If remarks are edited but revision doesn't bump within the same reporting date, cached analysis becomes stale silently.
seed_data_creation: None. Live Sheets sync; baseline 2026-09-17 with 333 people / 15 PODs / 4 TPMs. LLM cache doc auto-created for pod=Vidit Sharma via test_analyze_vidit_sharma_and_cache.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 test additions: TestTpmCounts, TestPodCounts, TestBlockerAnalysis (incl. real LLM call to 'Vidit Sharma' with 60s timeout), TestSummaryRegression. Fixed TestTpms.test_list to assert trinity/manual instead of target_coverage. Frontend selectors: pod-counts (5 children), tpm-counts (5 children), blocker-analysis card, run-blocker-analysis button, blocker-result. LLM call typically 10-15s; use >=45s timeout when waiting for blocker-result. The blocker_analyses collection caches per (pod, reporting_date, revision).
rca of the issue: N/A — no failing behavior. Only cleanup: iter-1 test TestTpms.test_list still expected legacy 'target_coverage' key that was removed in iter-3 backend refactor; updated the assertion to check 'trinity'/'manual' count keys instead.
